Name: Viola's Chinese Style Gold Clock and Obelisk
Author: Violablabla
Description:
[size=4][b]这个mod只在n网发布或者由我本人分发！！！！咸鱼淘宝黑心商滚蛋！[/b][/size]


Hello! [s]It's my first time making mods! So exciting!!!
[/s]
With this mod, you can have four chinese style obelisks[not seasonal] and a seasonal gold clock!!

[b]声明：[/b][b]我的方尖碑并非原创。是基于朴缜老师的中国城市系列绘卷《东方幻月录》创作的。由于我过于小透明，尽管联系了老师他也并未回复我。此次创作mod仅仅是为了分享娱乐，绝不用于任何商业用途，侵删。
[/b][b]Credits:[/b][b]The obelisks are based on Chinese artist Zhen Pu's painting, City of Moon. You can see his work here: https://weibo.com/338170707.
[/b]

[list]
[*][size=5]如何安装[/size]
[/list]把文件拖进“Mods”文件夹即可。[list]
[*][size=5]How To Install[/size]
[/list][size=3]Simply put this file into "Mods".[/size]


[list]
[*][size=5]如何使用[/size]
[/list][size=2]这个模组自动将你的方尖碑替换成美美的中式方尖碑。方尖碑没有四季变换。

黄金钟是四季自动变换的。黄金钟有两种表盘，一种是美化的（默认表盘，style 为 1），一种是普通表盘（Style为2）。你可以通过Generic Config Menu切换。

同时，你可以选择是否为黄金钟和方尖碑添加阴影。强烈建议不要添加，系统自带的阴影真的丑！！！！[/size]

[list]
[*][size=5]How To Use[/size]
[/list]This mod automatically replace original obelisks with the new ones. It is not compatible with other mods that edited obelisks as well.

There are [b]two types of gold clock[/b]. The default is the one I upload in the image file. You can change the dial plate through config.json or Generic Mod Config Menu.
Also,[b] you can choose to add with or without shadow[/b]. I strongly recommmend without shadow (which is the default)! Or the obelisks will look pretty weird.
